name: Mabel Highfell

goals.text: make Beatrix Goldcrest pay for buying my bannerman
wed their heir into a great house

memories: The Treason of Sunstone: House Goldcrest sends gold to Sunstone hidden in wine casks. Odette Dale buys horses and says they're for the tourney.
Odette Dale will not come to Highfell. A loyal man comes when called.
The Treason of Sunstone: Odette Dale finally rides to Highfell, between two lines of House Highfell's spearmen.
Odette Dale betrayed me and gave Sunstone to House Ironreach.
Beatrix Goldcrest bought my bannerman Odette Dale with gold. I took the traitor's head and I will have more.
voice: just, vengeful lord of House Highfell; speaks like a proud noble
